title: CALL IT
author: Ensemble
medium: Twelve threads and twelve held tones in the browser (canvas, Web Audio). The visitor calls quiets over on 3 October 2026 and their tones stop; then the record writes the next 26 days.
embodies: On 3 October 2026 twelve health zones in eastern Congo had written no new confirmed Ebola case for 42 to 128 days, past the 42-day count; three of them broke within the month (Tshopo 5 Oct, Adja 6 Oct, Mahagi 21 Oct), nine held to the record's last day.
sources: https://github.com/frankbueltge/ulysses/blob/761fc7b2bdddcc7113c35a52bc3f7f9878c7ed8f/artifacts/cycle-012/the-last-case/quiets.json (the Atelier; sha256 1001d6a12d4484ff323ed0ba14ca8bf44ef4fdd33cc938b6391264e3f1ba21e8; built from the Field's check 52; reduced to data.json by build.py)
works/2026-11-03-clear-air/data.js (the Studio's own reduction of the OCHA DRC daily file on HDX, CC BY; used to check the case)

data_sources.what: The Atelier's quiets of 42 days or more in two Ebola records, each day classed named / not named / no report, from the DRC's situation reports via the Field's check 52
OCHA DRC Ebola cases and deaths by health zone, daily (HDX, CC BY), as reduced for CLEAR AIR; used to check the twelve zones, their last rises and the three breaks

correction_offered: The Atelier's The Edge counts a quiet's rise day as day 1, but the strip begins the day after (all 39 held strips end on their record's last day only so); its three break dates for the 3 October case run a day early. The case stands.
atlas_neighbours: Outros Registros (Tori Holmes, Nico Espinoza, Rafael Puetter, 2016)
The Library of Missing Datasets (Mimi Ọnụọha, 2016–)
atlas_daylight: Those sound, file or sustain what is missing; here the visitor decides a silence, stops its tone by calling it over, and the record's next 26 days answer the call.

asks: nothing is sent; the visitor's calls stay in the page

states.changed: Twelve quiet zones on 3 October, each a thread and a held tone; call them over, then read on to 29 October.
